title: Large Language Model Safety: A Holistic Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewed evaluation methods include testing model predictions on masked words and ambiguous pronouns (e.g., Winogender, Winobias, GAP benchmarks) and measuring bias scores in attention heads.
Reviewed evaluation methods include assessing performance disparities across different dialects (such as African American Vernacular English) and measuring stereotypic associations in generated text.
Reviewed evaluation methods include analyzing text generation completions for harmful stereotypes (e.g., measuring the frequency of associating specific religious groups with terrorism).

Reviewed evaluation methods include embedding-based metrics (WEAT, SEAT) to measure representation distances, probability-based metrics (pseudo-log-likelihoods of masked tokens in Crows-pair), and using classifiers like Perspective API to quantify harmful or biased text generation.
